question: How many of our patients carry a heart failure dx? CHF, HFrEF/HFpEF, systolic or diastolic, whatever — I just want the headcount.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Distinct patients with a conditions record coded SNOMED 88805009, ICD-10 I50.*, or a description containing 'heart failure' or 'CHF' (e.g. 'Chronic congestive heart failure', 'Chronic systolic CHF', 'End-stage heart failure'). Condition records are undated; no medication or echo inference.

question: Need a list for the nephrology outreach pilot: every diabetic who also has chronic kidney disease on their problem list (staged CKD or ESRD — not just a generic 'diabetic kidney disorder' entry).
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Patient IDs with BOTH (a) diabetes: ICD-10 E10/E11/E13, SNOMED 44054006, a description containing 'diabetes mellitus' (excluding 'Family history of diabetes mellitus'), or 'T1DM'/'T2DM' — prediabetes, gestational diabetes and hypoglycemia codes excluded; AND (b) CKD: ICD-10 N18.*, description containing 'chronic kidney disease' or 'CKD', or end-stage renal disease (SNOMED 46177005). 'Disorder of kidney due to diabetes mellitus' alone does not satisfy (b). No lab-defined CKD.

question: quick one - how many pts have ever had an A1c of 6.5 or higher? any A1c result counts, dated or not, however the lab named it
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Distinct patients with any labs record named 'HbA1c', 'Hemoglobin A1c' or 'Hemoglobin A1c/Hemoglobin.total' with value >= 6.5 (%), regardless of whether the result has an event date. Diagnosis codes are not used.

question: Quality gap check: how many hypertensive patients have never had an LDL cholesterol result come into the system? Don't count pulmonary hypertension.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Systemic hypertension = conditions record with ICD-10 I10-I16, SNOMED 59621000, or a description containing 'hypertension' or 'HTN', excluding pulmonary hypertension. Count those with no labs record named 'LDL cholesterol' or 'LDL' (dated or undated) received by the as-of date. Total cholesterol/HDL/non-HDL do not count as LDL.

question: Pull everyone who has had an eGFR under 30 at any point. Only use the BSA-normalized eGFR results (mL/min/1.73m²) — skip any GFR reported in plain mL/min.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. 'Glomerular filtration rate' in plain 'mL/min' is excluded. Dated or undated results count; not restricted to the latest result.

question: For the weight management program sizing: how many patients have obesity documented on the problem list? Include BMI 30+/40+ codes and E66 codes, but not 'overweight' and not history-of entries.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. No vitals/BMI measurements used.

question: How many of our 65+ patients have both heart failure AND anemia on their problem list?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Both conditions required; no lab-defined anemia.

question: Respiratory registry count please - asthma or COPD (emphysema and chronic obstructive bronchitis count as COPD). Acute bronchitis doesn't.

question: How many patients have had an LDL >= 190 at any time? Thinking about possible familial hypercholesterolemia screening.

question: Pharmacy safety huddle: how many patients have had a potassium over 5.0 drawn so far this year?

question: Can you break out ED visits by quarter for 2029 so far?

Visit date = encounter event_date; undated encounters excluded. Quarter label 'YYYY-Qn'. Columns: quarter, ed_visits. Quarters with no visits are omitted.

question: Urgent care volume in 2026 by payer type (commercial/medicare/medicaid/uninsured)?

question: What was our ED utilization per 1,000 members for calendar 2026? Use the whole roster as the denominator.

question: Inpatient admits by half-year for 2026 — H1 vs H2. Don't count obs stays.

question: For the practice scorecards: 2029 YTD ED visits broken out by each patient's attributed primary care practice.

question: Of the ED visits in 2026, how many got an in-person clinic follow-up within 7 days? Phone calls and telehealth don't count.
